'''Starcaller''' is a blue drake located in [[Starshard Cradle]] in [[Moonwhisper Coast]]. After the arcane meteor was called down by the blue dragonflight, Starcaller and a brood of the blue flight began occupying the impact site, driving away anything that comes too close - adventurers, scholars and even the naga have learned to give it a wide berth. [[Zarazar Sagewind]] wants the drake killed and [[Gor'dush Jawtaker]] seeks to acquire its jaw.

==Objective of==
* Must be killed for {{questlong|Alliance|58+|A Star That Calls Back}}.
* Drops [[Jaw of Starcaller]] for {{questlong|Horde|58+|Jawtaker}}.
